Split h=0 cases at central k and complement all bits for h=1, proving every trajectory, the two possible terminal phase types, and sharp bounds F^4=F^3 (even r) or F^4=F^2 (odd r). For odd r the balanced labelled nonhub bits genuinely complement in each two-cycle, not just their count. There are C(r,floor r/2) such h=0 states and their complement h=1 partners; binomial weights yield all four nonzero classes, with total 2^(r+2). Independent full bitmask updates of 8176 initial labelled states for r=2..10 give exactly those classes. This finite check corroborates the symbolic all-r case split.
